name: lui-language
description: Support for WGS LUI syntax with diagnostics, autocomplete, navigation and Lua integration.

lui.fileExtensions.description: Define additional file extensions (compatibility setting from LUI Language 0.1.x).

lunaUI.diagnostics.unknownProperties.description: Severity for properties not found in the built-in or workspace index. Keep off when project widgets define properties dynamically.

lunaUI.diagnostics.unknownElements.description: Severity for inherited or instantiated elements not found in the workspace index. Native UI* classes are accepted.

lunaUI.diagnostics.unknownColorAliases.description: Severity for named colors not found in Color::registerAlias or indexed .lml/.otml color files.

lunaUI.index.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of LUI, Lua and C++ files scanned for project symbols.

lunaUI.index.exclude.description: Glob excluded from the project symbol scan.

lunaUI.styleSources.description: Ordered external style sources. When set, markup styles are loaded only from this list; Lua/C++ APIs are still indexed from the open workspace.

name.description: Name shown in the load-order report.

path.description: Absolute path or path using ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolder:name}, ${env:VAR} or ~.

files.description: Optional explicit relative file/directory order inside path. Without it, markup files are loaded recursively in lexical path order.

lunaUI.colors.decorations.enabled.description: Show the resolved color swatch beside hexadecimal colors and Luna UI color aliases. The editor.colorDecorators VS Code setting must also be enabled.

lunaUI.assets.hoverPreview.enabled.description: Show a local image preview when hovering static image-source, icon-source and *-image-source values. Dynamic ! values are ignored.

lunaUI.assets.referenceHighlight.enabled.description: Keep static image and Font Awesome references highlighted in link-blue while preserving native hover and Ctrl+Click behavior.

lunaUI.assets.automaticSearch.enabled.description: Before configured sources, resolve assets relative to the LUI file, open workspace folders and their ancestors. Also recognizes when the opened folder is the assets directory itself.

lunaUI.assets.sources.description: Ordered fallback filesystem mounts used after automatic asset discovery. A string mounts its path at /.

anyOf.description: Directory mounted at Luna UI virtual /.

prefix.description: Luna UI virtual prefix mapped to path; for example /assets.

lunaUI.assets.extensions.description: Extensions tried in order when an image source omits its extension.

lunaUI.fontAwesome.hoverPreview.enabled.description: Render static @FontAwesome-style-size-xcode icon sources in hover using a project-local font.

lunaUI.fontAwesome.fontPath.description: Fallback Font Awesome .ttf/.otf/.woff file or directory. Automatic discovery checks /assets/fonts first. Accepts ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolder:name}, ${env:VAR} and ~.

lunaUI.luaIntegration.enabled.description: Delegate dynamic ! values and Lua-backed @slot/@slotRet/@field/@bind constructs to the installed Lua extension.

enumDescriptions: Treat @bind globals as dynamic Lua objects, allowing project-defined fields without false inject-field diagnostics.
Use strict UIWidget annotations. Choose this only when the Lua environment declares UIWidget and bound widgets are not extended with arbitrary fields.
lunaUI.luaIntegration.bindGlobalType.description: LuaLS type emitted for globals declared by @bind.
